findings.explanation: You are required to perform unspecified additional services without any guaranteed extra pay, and there is no change-order mechanism to adjust your compensation for out-of-scope tasks.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall perform the services specifically set forth herein, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be set forth in a written change order specifying the mutually agreed scope of work and corresponding compensation.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. I am looking forward to moving forward and have one small suggestion regarding the agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause, it currently requires performing unspecified additional services without guaranteed extra compensation, and I propose modifying it so that any additional services are set forth in a written change order specifying the mutually agreed scope of work and corresponding compensation. Thank you for your consideration.
